name: http-metadata
assertions: projects display metadata through real proposal and GET while preserving the exact canonical summary

name: copy-at-proposal
assertions: freezes display metadata at proposal and in each read, outside audit and execution authority

name: fallback-match
assertions: keeps the original line and action for absent or unsupported display metadata ({"v":1,"fallback":"foreign","parts":["changed"]})

name: metadata-version
assertions: keeps the original line and action for absent or unsupported display metadata ({"v":2,"fallback":"original","parts":["changed"]})
retained Hub summary fallback still works when a future descriptor is unknown

name: argument-shape
assertions: keeps the original line and action for absent or unsupported display metadata ({"v":1,"fallback":"original","parts":[{"key":"settings_confirm.summary.fingerprint","args":["extra"]}]})
keeps the original line and action for absent or unsupported display metadata ({"v":1,"fallback":"original","parts":[{"key":"settings_confirm.summary.in_effect","args":[{}]}]})

name: ui-budget
assertions: keeps the original line and action for absent or unsupported display metadata ({"v":1,"fallback":"original","parts":[""]})

name: store-budget
assertions: bounds optional display metadata and preserves the underlying rendered record on malformed hints
